```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
DATASET <- "QDS"
ModelConfig <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
RESPONSES <- as.character(ModelConfig$responses$names)
RESPONSE_LABELS <- c(
  ppv = "PPV",
  ppvL = "PPV.L",
  ppvT = "PPV.T",
  ppvV = "PPV.V",
  ppa = "PPA",
  ppaL = "PPA.L",
  ppaT = "PPA.T",
  ppaV = "PPA.V"
)
PathDataset <- file.path(root, "data", "datasets", sprintf("%s.csv", DATASET))
PathResiduals <- file.path(root, "data", "summary", "residuals_oof.csv")
PathSources <- file.path(root, "data", "domains", "sources.csv")
if (!length(RESPONSES) ||
    !setequal(names(RESPONSE_LABELS), RESPONSES) ||
    any(!file.exists(c(
  PathDataset, PathResiduals, PathSources
)))) {
  stop("model.support: required model products are missing.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- "Model-fitting observations and OOF pairs for the retained formulation, by data source and response. Available observations are those with finite response values in the independent formulation; OOF pairs are the observation--prediction pairs in the retained OOF residual table. Distance and maximum instantaneous charge (MIC) ranges refer to the available observations."
}
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-model-support
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "model.support.R"))
TBL
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP, DATASET, ModelConfig, PathDataset, PathResiduals, PathSources,
   RESPONSE_LABELS, RESPONSES)
```
